title: Hello, world description: Why this blog is built from a single Sitefile. tags: [meta, sitefile]

This blog is a folder of Markdown files and three templates. A Sitefile turns them into static HTML — no framework, no node_modules, no container.

Each post starts with a little frontmatter:

title: Hello, world
tags: [meta, sitefile]

The file name gives the date and the URL: 2026-01-05-hello-world.md becomes /posts/hello-world/.
